name: Rugs
intro: Turkish rugs in stock at Wool & Loom warehouses in New Jersey, Georgia, Texas, and California.
seoText: Every rug is priced from a reference size, then scaled by area. An 8 by 10 is not the same price as a 5 by 7 of the same design. Measure in feet and inches before you order.

faq.question: How is a larger size priced?
faq.answer: The price of each size is the reference price times the ratio of the areas. A 9 by 12 has more square feet than an 8 by 10, so it costs more.

faq.question: Which warehouse ships to me?
faq.answer: The product page names the warehouse. New Jersey covers the Northeast, Georgia the Southeast, Texas the South Central states, and California the West.

name: Oushak
intro: Pale fields, soft florals, and open medallions woven in Turkey.
seoText: Oushak rugs from Wool & Loom use ivory, apricot, and sage. They are stocked in U.S. warehouses and sold by the foot.

faq.question: Will an Oushak look pink in photos and orange in the room?
faq.answer: Apricot and rose on these pieces are muted. The photos are of the actual ground color, not a stylized filter.

name: Vintage
intro: Older wool pieces with softened color, still sound enough to put in a living room.
seoText: Vintage rugs at Wool & Loom are hand-knotted wool with worn, sun-faded color. Each one is a single piece, not a reproduced print.

faq.question: Are vintage rugs one of a kind?
faq.answer: Yes. The size on the page is the size of that rug. We do not cut a vintage piece down to order.

name: Runners
intro: Hall and entry runners from 2 by 8 to 3 by 12 feet.
seoText: Wool & Loom runners are sized for hallways. Leave about two inches of floor along each long edge so the runner does not touch the baseboard.

faq.question: How wide should a hall runner be?
faq.answer: Most halls want a 2-foot or 3-foot width. Measure the clear width in inches and subtract about four inches so the runner is not wall to wall.

name: Washable
intro: Low-pile rugs you can wash at home on cold.
seoText: Washable rugs are for kitchens, nurseries, and family rooms. They are not a substitute for a hand-knotted wool rug, and the page says so.

faq.question: Can I wash a wool rug the same way?
faq.answer: No. Only rugs marked washable go in a home washer. Wool pieces are cleaned by quote.

name: Turkish
intro: Sivas, Hereke, Milas, Konya, and Dosemealti patterns in wool.
seoText: Turkish rugs at Wool & Loom are hand-knotted or flatwoven in Turkey and held in U.S. stock.

faq.question: Are these new or vintage?
faq.answer: The Turkish collection is newly woven. Older pieces are in Vintage.

name: Persian-style
intro: Medallion and garden layouts woven in Turkey in a Persian-style drawing.
seoText: These are Persian-style rugs woven in Turkey, not antiques from Iran. The drawing is a medallion, garden, or Heriz-style corner.

faq.question: Are these imported from Iran?
faq.answer: No. They are woven in Turkey for Wool & Loom and stocked in the United States.

name: Furniture
intro: Sofas, tables, and chairs chosen to sit on a rug, with sizes in feet.
seoText: Wool & Loom furniture is scaled for the rugs we sell. A coffee table should sit fully on the rug. The front legs of a sofa or chair should rest on it.

faq.question: Do you deliver furniture upstairs?
faq.answer: Stairs and long carries are quoted with pickup and delivery. The product price does not include a walk-up.

name: Sofas
intro: Sofas from six to eight feet wide, in linen, boucle, and performance cloth.
seoText: Place a sofa so the front legs land on the rug. An 8 by 10 usually fits a seven-foot sofa with a coffee table.

faq.question: What rug size fits a sofa?
faq.answer: A seven-foot sofa usually wants an 8 by 10 or a 9 by 12 so the front legs and the coffee table share the rug.

name: Coffee Tables
intro: Oak, walnut, travertine, and steel tables sized to sit fully on a rug.
seoText: Coffee tables at Wool & Loom are about four to five feet long. They should sit entirely on the rug, not half on the floor.

faq.question: Should the table match the rug?
faq.answer: No. A plain wood or stone top lets the rug be the pattern in the room.

name: Accent Chairs
intro: Chairs meant to share the rug with the sofa, not sit off on bare floor.
seoText: Front legs of an accent chair should rest on the same rug as the sofa so the seating reads as one group.

faq.question: Can a chair sit half off the rug?
faq.answer: Put the front legs on the rug. Leaving only the back legs on makes the chair look like it slipped off.

name: Side Tables
intro: Small tables that can sit on a rug beside a sofa or chair.
seoText: Side tables from Wool & Loom are small enough to place on the rug next to a seat without covering the medallion.

faq.question: Do side tables have to match the coffee table?
faq.answer: They should share a material or a finish, not necessarily the same design.
